continuity: Compare faces, clothes and props across shots; keep each person on the same screen side.
mouth_sync: Check mouth onset within 100 to 200 ms of speech. Report measured correlation below 0.4 per failing line.
caption_timing: Compare captions with word timestamps; start error must stay below 0.15 s.
tail: Keep the tail after the last sound under 0.3 s.
shot_length: Measure shot lengths; no shot exceeds 2.5 s.
words_per_second: Measure speech pace from word timestamps; target 2 to 3 words per second.
mute_test: Watch the muted file; the story and offer must remain clear.
orientation: Verify final dimensions match the selected aspect ratio.
black_corners: Inspect the final file for black corners caused by crops or motion.
eyes: Inspect eyelines and eye artifacts in each person shot.
loudness_master: Measure the final file: integrated target -14 LUFS, inclusive band -16 to -12 LUFS; true peak at or below -1 dBTP.
caption_ocr: OCR captions from the final file; character error rate must be 0.10 or less for each caption.
voice_consistency: Measure max/min per-line median pitch per character. Spread at or below 1.25 passes; above 1.25 through 1.6 needs OWNER CHECK; above 1.6 fails. Missing line stems or character mapping means NOT CHECKED. Pitch does not prove voice fit.
stem_sfx: Measure SFX sync and level from separate voice and SFX stems. A mixed track cannot measure them separately. Missing stems means NOT CHECKED. Compare cues with picture events; R25 stings start within 0.2 s. Record level relative to voice and request owner listening review.
